summary.one_liner: A curated awesome-list of Jupyter projects, libraries, hosted services, and learning resources, organized by category.
summary.what_it_does: This is an "awesome" list rather than a software project: it links to Jupyter-related tools and resources with a one-line description for each. Sections cover runtimes and frontends, collaboration and education tools, visualization and table widgets, notebook rendering, publishing and conversion, version control and diffing, JupyterLab extensions, testing, domain-specific projects, hosted notebook platforms, official documentation, community resources, and articles and tutorials. Entries are short descriptions with links; the list itself contains no code to install. A sponsor blurb for Deepnote appears at the top and was ignored.
use_cases: find a JupyterLab extension for a specific need
find tools for diffing or versioning notebooks
find notebook-to-PDF, HTML, or markdown converters
find widgets for interactive charts and data grids in Jupyter
discover Jupyter tutorials and learning material
notable: Broad coverage: runtimes, JupyterLab extensions, visualization widgets, testing tools, and hosted platforms in one list
Each entry carries a short one-line description of what the linked project does
Includes education tools such as nbgrader and JupyterHub setup guides
Listed as a reference from vinta/awesome-python under Interactive Interpreter
caveats: Curated list only; it does not itself provide software, and linked projects vary in maintenance status
Some entries are commercial or hosted services with paid tiers, and the README does not detail which ones
